$comment: Kit performance budgets (TOG-22120). Measured baseline 2026-10-12 (raw/gzip bytes): worker entry 2551/1219; server JS total (22 files, no sourcemaps) 962157/258300 — dominated by the Hono catch-all bundle (chunks/hono.js 433009); client JS total (11 files) 100252/39302; client CSS total (1 file) 2402/763. Ceilings are measured size x1.25 rounded up (raw to 512B, gzip to 256B), the repository x1.25 rule from ci/bundle-budget.json. Client/server hashed-asset groups are budgeted as totals plus a file-count cap, so a new chunk fails closed instead of escaping enforcement. Startup (first-200 of the built Worker on loopback) is enforced by the kit-parity Playwright project against startup.maxMs. Raising a ceiling needs an explicit decision explaining the growth; never relax a budget to make CI green.
